subject: Reconfiguring demo after added governance & infra reviewers
messages:
From: Linda Harris <linda.harris@aventishealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@aventishealth.com>, Tara Gomez <tara.gomez@aventishealth.com>, Mark Liu <mark.liu@aventishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to expand attendee list / potential reschedule

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Quick heads-up: we've had a last-minute internal review and need to include a few additional reviewers for the upcoming demo on May 11 — security (Raj Patel), procurement (Tara Gomez) and infra/platform (Mark Liu). Given the scope they'll want to see both the platform integration and the data governance controls.

Raj will be traveling May 11–13 and Tara's only free window next week is May 15. Mark can be flexible but would prefer earlier in the week. With that mix, could we either:
- move the single demo to a new date when everyone can attend, or
- split into two shorter sessions (technical deep dive + governance/procurement) so we can accommodate travel schedules?

Open to your recommendation — we want to avoid a follow-up session if possible.

Thanks,
Linda
Director, Product Strategy
Aventis Health
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Linda Harris <linda.harris@aventishealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@aventishealth.com>, Tara Gomez <tara.gomez@aventishealth.com>, Mark Liu <mark.liu@aventishealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to expand attendee list / potential reschedule

Thanks for the update, Linda — and welcome, Raj / Tara / Mark.

Short answer: we can do either. My recommendation to keep momentum is to split into two focused 30–45 minute sessions:
• Technical deep-dive (platform/integration, latency/cost controls, runtime requirements) — led by our Platform engineer (Vivek).
• Governance & procurement walkthrough (data retention, audit logs, commercial terms, SOW) — led by me + Marissa.

Proposed slots (PT):
A) Tue May 12 — 10:00–10:45 (single session)
B) Thu May 14 — Tech deep-dive 10:00–10:30; Fri May 15 — Governance/procurement 09:00–09:30 (two short sessions)
C) Wed May 13 — afternoon (flexible)

If Raj is traveling May 11–13 and Tara prefers May 15, option B looks most likely to hit everybody. Vivek — can you cover the tech portion if we split? Priyom — can you own the follow-up SOW and add the draft to the calendar invite once times are confirmed?

I'll hold off on changing calendar invites until you all confirm which approach works.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

> Thanks for the update, Linda — and welcome, Raj / Tara / Mark.

Thanks — sorry for the late reply. I am traveling May 11–13 and can only join after 15:00 PT on Tue May 12 (unlikely to be useful) or on Thu May 14. I can definitely make Thu May 14 for the tech session. For procurement/governance, Tara is the blocker — she told me she can do Fri May 15 AM. If you can split it B looks good.

— Raj

Agree — let's split. To summarize the proposed plan:
- Thu May 14, 10:00–10:30 PT — Technical deep-dive (Vivek + Platform team)
- Fri May 15, 09:00–09:30 PT — Governance, procurement & SOW review (Marissa + Soojin)

I'll update the agenda to reflect two short sessions and attach the revised agenda. Priyom — once Soojin confirms we'll send calendar invites to the full attendee list and include the SOW draft so procurement can review before the meeting.

Attachments: Aventis_Demo_Agenda_v3.pdf

Thanks — I'll stand by for the final confirmation and will build the invites immediately after.

— Marissa

Attendees: Raj Patel (Security), Mark Liu (Infra), Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood Platform), Soojin Lee (Redwood) + engineering SME
